Author: Tensho
Name: Tensho Assistant
Description:
Everyday tools in one window (/tensho), with a guide and help on every page.

Items and storage (bags, retainers, saddlebags, armoury chest, glamour dresser, armoire), inventory sorting rules, market listings and prices, retainer sale prices compared on a click, recipes, a crafting simulator and solver, gathering and fishing with Eorzea time windows and weather, a map that replaces the game map (quests, leves, FATEs, gathering points, vendors, aether currents, teleport costs), weather, alarms and reminders, free company voyages and builds, quests and rewards, collections with how to obtain each item, a gear planner (materia, try on, build sharing), duty and monster loot, Beastmaster information, Fashion Report hints, Mini Cactpot, Triple Triad helpers (against NPCs only), character stats, macro chains and a Credits page listing every source.

Network: community data (Universalis, Garland Tools, FFXIV Console Games Wiki, Teamcraft bite times, PaissaDB open plots, and files hosted on GitHub: LuminaSupplemental, GatherBuddy, FFXIVGachaSpreadsheet) is requested over HTTPS only when you open or hover the matching tool, click, or a setting asks for it, with bounded replies and a disk cache. Each source has a switch in Settings › Data and sources. This plugin's own repository is read on a click for the gallery of community tools (data only, no code) and the help videos, and for the shared discoveries exchange on « Exchange now » or with the optional automatic exchange (off by default), without any account. Your own sightings (places, items, the day of each; a fish caught carries your character's exact spot) are sent to an unlisted gist linked from a public issue only after you connect GitHub. On « Install », the optional desktop app is downloaded from this repository's releases (SHA-256 checked). No character name or id is sent; Tensho alarms and currency cap alerts go to a Discord webhook only if you enter one (off by default), with your character's name only if you ask for it. An item's page on the wiki or the Lodestone, and partake.gg (player events), open in your browser only on a click or a /tensho command. Reporting a problem shows the exact text first; it leaves only on your click, as a public issue through your GitHub connection if you made one, else as a prefilled form in your browser that you send yourself.

Actions that reach the game (teleport, applying a sort, a macro chain, writing crafting macros, opening Try On, equipping a gear set, sending the hunt train call to the chat channel you choose) start only when you click them. Game alarms are created with /alarm when you add an alarm with the « Also create the alarms in the game » setting on (off by default) or press « Send to the game ». Two settings act without a click: the M key opens Tensho's map instead of the game's (on by default; Settings › Map), and the title you chose for a job is worn when you change job (off by default). No automation of crafting, dialogues or loot, no PvP feature, no parser.

AI disclosure: the code and the icon were generated with an AI coding agent (Claude), directed and tested in game by the author.

Languages: English and French; German and Japanese: menu titles only.
Punchline: One window for everyday tools: items, crafting, gathering, map, collections and more.
